calc_design_slope_legend: Inclined plane: reference point, gradient and direction it falls
calc_filter_ground: Filter out excavators, containers and vegetation
calc_need_region: A stockpile needs at least one area around the pile.
calc_need_two: A calculation needs two checked captures: before and after excavation.
calc_no_regions: Without an area, the whole overlap of both captures is calculated.
calc_no_regions_export: Without an area, the whole capture is exported.
calc_series_captures: Captures in time order – the first is the original ground
calc_slope_z: Height at the reference point in m
calc_stockpile_hint: Draw the boundary around the pile; the base comes from the ground along the boundary.
calc_text: Compares two captures and determines cut and fill per area.
calc_text_compare: Compares a capture with a design height, an inclined plane or a design surface.
calc_text_export: Elevation model, contours and surface for CAD and surveying.
calc_text_georef: Brings a point cloud into the site's coordinate system using identical points. The result is a new capture.
calc_text_series: Progress over the construction phase: each capture against the original ground and the previous one.
calc_text_stockpile: Volume of a pile against a base surface, per area.
captures_empty: No captures yet. Upload a point cloud (LAS, LAZ, XYZ) or an elevation model (GeoTIFF), e.g. from OpenDroneMap.
captures_text: Point clouds and elevation models in ETRS89/UTM32 (EPSG:25832).
compare_axis: Deviation actual − design in cm. Red: too high, blue: too low, green: within tolerance.
compare_distribution_text: Share of the area per deviation
doc_empty: Nothing documented yet. Photos with GPS appear at their location in the view.
doc_text: Constraint points with target height, photos with position and notes for the site.
error_offline: The server is not responding right now. Your data is not lost. Please try again shortly.
error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
export_ortho: Orthophoto as GeoTIFF (RGBA, clipped to the regions)
flight_description: Mapping flight over a region as a mission for DJI Pilot 2: lines from ground resolution and overlap.
flight_no_regions: Add a region first to plan a flight.
flight_start_hint: Flight time without transit. Heights are relative to the take-off point. In Pilot 2 open Flight Route → Import and check before the first flight.
flight_terrain: Height difference in the region {relief} m (capture “{capture}”): taking off at mid height, the ground resolution varies by ± {percent} %.
georef_not_determinable: Nothing can be determined from these points
georef_paste_label: One line per point: name, x, y, z in the capture, east, north, height
login_passkey_name: Enter your name first to sign in with a passkey.
login_setup_text: Create the first account. It gets all permissions and can invite more users.
login_text: Sign in with your Fixpunkt account.
odm_off: Drone photos need a NodeODM server. Until then, upload the point cloud from WebODM as a capture.
odm_offset_hint: Subtracted from every height, e.g. the height anomaly for DHHN2016. 0 if heights are already right.
odm_offset_invalid: Height offset as a number in m, e.g. 47.25
odm_result_converted: Converted to the site's zone, height offset of {offset} m subtracted.
odm_started: Running in NodeODM. The point cloud appears under captures when it is done.
odm_text: Upload the photos of a flight. NodeODM turns them into a point cloud that appears as a new capture.
odm_unreachable: NodeODM does not answer at the configured address.
overview_compare: Last plan vs. actual within tolerance
overview_progress: Excavation per flight (against the original terrain)
overview_stock_none: No stockpile calculation for the stockpiles yet.
passkeys_description: Sign in without a password – with fingerprint, face or device PIN, a security key or your password manager.
plans_against: Heights from the plan against the capture “{name}”
plans_empty: No plans yet. DXF with lines, texts and spot heights in the site's coordinate system.
plans_no_capture: No checked capture to compare with yet
plans_report: Plan vs. actual of “{name}” as PDF
plans_text: Site and construction plans as DXF: as background in the view, heights for plan vs. actual.
regions_empty: No areas yet. Upload a boundary as GeoJSON, e.g. from QGIS.
regions_text: Billing boundaries as GeoJSON – metric or in longitude/latitude.
report_coverage_warning: In at least one area, data is missing for more than 5 % of the surface. These spots are not included – check whether the captures cover the area completely.
report_method: Grid method, cell size {cm} cm. Balance = fill − cut.
report_method_stockpile: Grid method, cell size {cm} cm. Volume above the base surface per area.
report_wait: The calculation is running. The page updates by itself.
server_api_internal: The server ran into an error. Your data is not lost.
server_auth_csrf: The session has expired. Please reload the page.
server_auth_forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
server_auth_lastAdmin: The last admin cannot be deleted.
server_auth_passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
server_auth_sessionRequired: An API token cannot manage tokens or passkeys.
server_auth_setupDone: Fixpunkt is already set up. Please sign in.
server_captures_unsupportedFile: Fixpunkt does not know this file format. Supported: LAS, LAZ, XYZ, CSV, GeoTIFF and ASC.
server_georef_invalid: These control points do not determine a transformation – too few points or all on one line.
server_jobs_captureNotReady: The capture is still being checked. Please wait a moment.
server_jobs_wrongSite: The capture or area belongs to another site.
server_markers_needsPosition: A constraint point needs east, north and target height.
server_markers_notAnImage: This is not a photo (JPG or PNG).
server_odm_notConfigured: NodeODM is not set up. An admin sets FIXPUNKT_NODEODM_URL.
server_odm_notDraft: Processing has started; photos can no longer be changed.
server_odm_unsupportedImage: Only photos as JPG, TIFF or PNG.
server_ortho_invalid: This is not a readable orthophoto (GeoTIFF with position, RGB or RGBA).
server_passkeys_disabled: Passkeys are not set up on this server (FIXPUNKT_PUBLIC_URL).
server_passkeys_failed: The passkey could not be verified.
server_passkeys_none: There is no passkey for this name.
server_plans_invalid: The file is not a readable DXF drawing (or contains nothing to display).
server_regions_invalidGeojson: The file contains no valid polygon (GeoJSON).
site_delete_text: All captures, areas and calculations of this site are removed for good.
sites_new_text: A site collects captures, billing areas and calculations.
sites_subtitle: Captures, areas and volumes per site
target_stock_hint: The stock comes from the stockpile calculation per flight.
tokens_description: For programs and scripts: send as “Authorization: Bearer …”. A token has the permissions of your account.
tokens_once: The token is shown only now – copy it and keep it safe:
users_new_text: Hand over the initial password in person; it can be changed under “Account”.
users_subtitle: Who may use Fixpunkt and for what
view3d_label: Terrain in 3D. Drag to rotate, right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom, arrow keys to pan.
view3d_no_webgl: The 3D view needs WebGL, which this browser does not offer.
view_canvas_label: Elevation map of the site. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, 0 fits, Enter sets a point at the crosshair.
view_draw_hint: Set the boundary's points one after another, at least three; the area closes itself.
view_keys: Drag to pan, wheel to zoom
view_pick_hint: Click the elevation map to set points.
view_profile_caption: Section along the line; height in m, length on the right.
view_profile_label: Profile over {length} m, height from {from} to {to}
view_text: Elevation map of the capture. Measure and draw areas right in the image.
view_trace_hint: Set points along the line one after another, at least two; the height comes from the terrain below.
